BSF Enterprise PLC
Publication of Technical White Paper on T-Rex Leather™
BSF Enterprise PLC ("BSF" or the "Company"), a biotech platform company driving a bio-sustainable future , is pleased to announce that its subsidiary, Lab-Grown Leather Ltd ("LGL") , has published a comprehensive technical white paper titled "Facts Behind T-Rex Leather™". Link to paper can be found here:
https://bsfenterprise.com/research
The document details the foundational engineering biology, structural performance benefits, and luxury sector market potential of the company's proprietary T-Rex Leather™ product line. Authored by BSF Enterprise's Chief Scientific Officer Dr. Ricardo Gouveia, PhD - a leading biochemist with over 50 peer-reviewed publications and 30 patents - the publication highlights how BSF's underlying platform technology is successfully scaling beyond medical applications into highly disruptive, zero-waste premium materials.
The key commercial drivers to this bio-material engineering milestone include:
1. Recreation of T-Rex Collagen:
●
The T-Rex Leather™ project began with the isolation of soft tissue from 68-million-year-old T. rex fossils. Only fragments of the collagen protein were recovered, so advanced AI-powered protein modeling was used to reconstruct the full sequence, resulting in a version called Gen4-3. This sequence had enhanced structural features, such as higher lysine content for stronger protein bonds.
●
The reconstructed protein sequence was converted into DNA, optimized, and inserted into animal cell lines to express functional T-Rex collagen.
2. Scaffold-Free Tissue Engineering:
●
Using LGL's proprietary Advanced Tissue Engineering Platform (ATEP™), the team cultivated skin tissue from cells expressing T-Rex collagen. Unlike other methods, this process is scaffold-free, meaning no synthetic or animal-derived scaffolds are used. Instead, cells grow in a crowded liquid medium that mimics natural conditions, resulting in a dense, authentic skin matrix.
●
This approach allows for the production of skin tissues of any size or thickness within weeks, using sustainable, non-toxic tanning methods. The resulting T-Rex Leather™ is strong, customisable, and environmentally friendly.
3. Industrial Scaling and Business Model:
●
The ATEP™ platform offers cost and efficiency advantages by reducing the need for expensive growth factors and eliminating the need for scaffolds. This enables LGL to move quickly from boutique production to high-volume supply and licensing agreements.
●
The technology allows for precise tuning of the leather's properties, making it suitable for various luxury and industrial applications.
4. Impact on the Luxury Sector:
●
T-Rex Leather™ challenges traditional luxury paradigms by offering a material that is not a replica but a "resurrected" resource, creating a new narrative of exclusivity.
●
The product is fully biodegradable, cruelty-free, plastic-free, and traceable, addressing both luxury and sustainability demands.
5. Market Positioning:
●
LGL targets the ultra-luxury segment first, using high-margin, exclusive products to fund further development and scaling. This strategy is designed to attract attention from elite brands and facilitate broader commercial adoption.
●
The technology positions LGL to capitalise on the growing global leather and smart textiles markets, offering a sustainable alternative to animal and petrochemical-based materials.
Consequently, the underlying ATEP™ technology (which can be applied to many other forms of cultivated leather) can transition seamlessly from producing bespoke art objects into fulfilling lucrative, high-volume supply agreements across the massive global leather goods and smart textile markets, permanently redefining the industrial reliance on animal agriculture while entirely avoiding the crutch of petrochemical plastics.
The board views the publication of this white paper as a key commercial validation event , demonstrating that BSF's technology is thoroughly validated and operational, and ready to capture substantial value within expanding global verticals.
Ends

BSF Enterprise PLC
Strategic Update May 2026
BSF Enterprise PLC (
"BSF"
or the
"Company"
), a biotech platform company driving a bio-sustainable future through its three high-growth subsidiaries, announces updates to its strategic operations for 1/2-year 2026.
The activities are
structured to accelerate commercialisation with imminent value-inflection milestones across BSF's three subsidiaries -beyond any existing research and development (R&D).
Key Milestones & Near-Term Catalysts
Lab-Grown Leather Ltd (LGL) - Lead Catalyst (June 2026)
●
World-First Product Launch:
LGL has developed
T-Rex Leather™
- high-end leather alternative grown from synthetic dinosaur DNA using BSF's proprietary
ATEP™
scaffold-free tissue manufacturing platform.
●
Paris Auction:
A tanned T-Rex skin has been completed, and a world-first luxury avant-garde handbag has been manufactured by a Berlin-based designer. The item is scheduled to be auctioned on
June 11
at
Dourot,
a leading Paris auction house, supported by a global PR campaign and marketing by VML.
●
Spin-Out Pathway:
Post-catalyst, LGL will seek independent spin-out funding to scale production capacity, allowing it to raise capital at the subsidiary level without diluting BSF parent shareholders.
Kerato Ltd - Clinical Results & Commercialisation (Q3-Q4 2026)
●
LiQD Cornea™ Hydrogel:
Targeting the expanding corneal transplant world market.
●
Veterinary Clinical Trials:
Phase 1 veterinary trials (50% funded by Canadian government grants) commenced in Q1 2026. Kerato has reached the midpoint of its PSO-funded development programme for LiQD Cornea, achieving key technical, regulatory and operational milestones. These include a successful pre-ITA engagement meeting with Health Canada and ongoing implementation of an ISO 13485-compliant quality management system to support future clinical translation activities.
●
Commercial Outlook:
Kerato aims to sign commercial distribution agreements in Q4 2026 , leading to first commercial veterinary sales in early 2027. Applications for human trials with Health Canada are planned for 2026-2027. Similar to LGL, a subsidiary-level self-funding spin-out is planned post-catalyst.
3D Bio-Tissues Ltd (3DBT) - Commercial Momentum (Active Now)
●
Revenue Generation:
Targeting the massive bio-based materials world market. 3DBT has commercially launched its
CytoBoost™ REVIVE
media factor
into biopharma
and
expanded sales of its
City-MixR
product into
cultivated meat sectors.
●
Sales Growth:
3DBT has experienced significant growth in customer orders
over a recent 3-month period.
●
Commercial Pipeline:
Secured a supply agreement with Seawith, yielding an active
£500,000 pipeline
. New cultivated meat partnerships and further biopharma client expansions are progressing through Q2 and Q3 2026.
Strategic Progress
The Board believes
2026
represents a critical time for BSF and its shareholders based on three key pillars:
1.
Progressing from R&D towards Commercialisation
:
T
he Company has made significant progress in translating its research programmes into commercial and clinical-stage activities
. The T-Rex leather exists, Kerato trials are live, and CytoBoost™ is shipping.
2.
Simultaneous Infrastructure Upside:
Unlike single-asset plays, there are three completely distinct high-growth assets simultaneously , distributing risk and multiplying potential upside events.
3.
Anti-Dilutive Spin-Out Structure:
The Board is evaluating potential subsidiary-level financing options, including possible spin-out structures, which may enable future growth capital to be raised at subsidiary level
.
Management Leadership
The execution of these commercial milestones is led by a highly experienced technical and capital markets management team:
●
Dr. Che Connon
(
Managing Director
): International leader in Tissue Engineering with over 100 publications; founder of four previous biotech spin-outs.
●
Geoff Baker (Executive Director):
Qualified lawyer (Australia & Hong Kong) with an extensive track record commercialising biomedical and industrial innovations.
●
Graham Duncan (CFO):
Chartered Accountant with more than 20 years of capital markets experience, holding an ICAEW Corporate Finance Diploma.
●
Ricardo Gouveia (CSO):
Bioengineering and biochemistry specialist with 20 years of dedicated research in stem cell and tissue biofabrication.
END

BSF Enterprise PLC:
A Historic Milestone in Luxury and Biotechnology -
World's First T-Rex Leather™ handbag to be auctioned
BSF Enterprise PLC ("BSF" or the "Company"), a global pioneer in lab-grown tissues and sustainable biotechnology, is pleased to announce a landmark event in the evolution of luxury materials. Its subsidiary, Lab-Grown Leather Limited, has officially appointed the prestigious Paris-based auction house Giquello SAS to facilitate the sale of the world
'
s first-ever product crafted from T-Rex Leather™.
Engineered using reconstructed dinosaur collagen and brought to life without harming a single animal, T-Rex
Leather™
made its first public debut
on 2 April,
where the one-of-a-kind, Enfin Leve designed handbag was unveiled at the Art Zoo in Amsterdam.
A Preeminent Stage for a Masterpiece
The auction will be a centerpiece of Giquello
'
s renowned Tentation
°
4 sale, scheduled for 11 June 2026 at the historic Drouot headquarter in Paris. Giquello SAS was specifically selected for its unrivaled expertise in natural history and high-value curiosity sales, providing the perfect bridge between prehistoric legacy and futuristic innovation.
VML Paris, a key partner in the creation of T-Rex Leather™ and a driver of its initial media success, will lead the promotion of the auction, ensuring this historic milestone resonates with audiences worldwide.
BSF views this auction as a transformative opportunity to showcase the Company
'
s innovation to the global market:
●
Global Prestige:
Hosting the event at Drouot, Paris-the epicenter of the French art market-elevates T-Rex Leather™ to the status of a masterpiece, engaging an elite international network of collectors and connoisseurs.
●
Market Disruption:
This milestone validates the commercial viability of the proprietary ATEP™ platform, demonstrating that cultivated leather can compete at the highest echelons of the luxury industry.
●
Brand Amplification:
Collaborating with VML Paris ensures a sophisticated campaign, positioning the brand prominently before luxury, technology, and design audiences worldwide.
CEO Perspective: Defining the Future of Luxury
Dr. Che Connon, CEO of BSF, stated:
"
The auction of the world
'
s first T-Rex Leather™ product in Paris is a watershed moment for our Company and our shareholders. By partnering with Giquello-a titan in the world of rare collectables-we are showcasing the immense value of our cultivated materials on a global stage. With the strategic support of VML Paris, we are not just selling a product; we are introducing a new asset class to the luxury market. This represents the pinnacle of what our biotechnology can achieve, merging the majesty of natural history with the ethics of tomorrow.
This is an exciting moment for T-Rex Leather™ and for the wider potential of cultivated materials in luxury, fashion and design.
"
Why This Matters for Shareholders
This auction serves as a powerful proof of concept for BSF
'
s ability to commercialize high-performance, ethical alternatives to conventional materials. As the world watches the hammer fall in Paris, BSF is solidified as a leader in the multi-billion dollar market for sustainable luxury.

Further details will be announced in due course, as appropriate.
END

Lab-Grown Leather for Ultra-Luxury Automotive & Advanced Robotics Skin
BSF Enterprise Plc (LSE: BSFA), (OTCQB: BSFAF), the biotechnology company focused on tissue engineering, lab-grown materials and bioactive solutions, is pleased to announce that it has executed a Heads of Terms where certain provisions are legally binding, establishing a Strategic Partnership with SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH ("SCHAKAU").
The partnership establishes a targeted commercial framework focused on two high-value growth pillars:
1. Luxury Automotive & Bespoke Materials: Rapid commercialisation of BSF's Lab-Grown Leather portfolio (including the T-Rex Leather™ concept) across bespoke, ultra-luxury programs with leading European automotive manufacturers.
2. Robotics Skin & Biological Human Interface Technologies: Industrial adoption of BSF's bio-engineered human skin equivalents and biological interface materials for humanoid and industrial robotics applications.
Key Highlights:
●
Direct Access to Leading European Luxury Automotive OEMs and Tier-1 Decision-Makers:
Establishes direct commercial conduits into ultra luxury vehicle manufacturers and specialised automotive engineering programs, targeting immediate 1-of-1 bespoke interior accents and trim applications.
●
Next-Generation Robotics Interfaces:
Leverages 3D Bio-Tissues' proprietary tissue-scaffolding technology to supply bio-engineered human skin equivalents as biological surface layers for humanoid and industrial robotic systems.
●
Performance-Aligned 6-Year Commercial Model:
The agreed commercial framework provides for a revenue share on SCHAKAU-originated programmes. Pre-SOP commercial revenues participate in the revenue share upon receipt but do not commence the six-year period.
Following First Commercial Production, the baseline revenue-share percentage per program (as agreed at that time) applies in full for Years 1-3, reducing to 50% of that percentage for Years 4-6, after which the revenue share ceases.
●
Performance-Based Equity Incentives:
The commercial framework contemplates a milestone-based equity and option programme, with any option or warrant vesting being 100% performance-contingent against defined commercial milestones
●
Strategic Capital Introduction Framework:
Capital introduced by SCHAKAU attracts a success fee of 5% up to £10m, 4% from £10m-£25m, 3% from £25m-£50m and 2% above £50m, payable in cash or equity on completion.
●
100% IP Ownership Retained
: BSF (via subsidiaries 3D Bio-Tissues Ltd and Lab-Grown Leather Ltd) retains absolute, 100% ownership of all underlying patents, scaffolds, trade secrets, and cell-manufacturing workflows.
●
Opportunity-Specific Exclusivity:
SCHAKAU will have exclusivity in respect of commercial opportunities introduced by it and acknowledged or deemed acknowledged under the Heads of Terms, subject to agreed protections for BSF's pre-existing relationships and an inactivity mechanism allowing BSF to withdraw exclusivity from a specific target following 180 consecutive days without substantive commercial interaction.
Pillar 1: Luxury Automotive & OEM Expansion
Through SCHAKAU's established industry network, BSF is positioning its Lab-Grown Leather (LGL) platform directly within the ultra-premium automotive sector. Initial commercialisation will focus on high-margin, bespoke interior trim, steering elements, and luxury accents (under BSF's proprietary T-Rex Leather™ hallmark).
This bespoke approach enables BSF to generate early commercial traction and high-margin product revenue without requiring immediate large-scale industrial manufacturing infrastructure, while establishing direct relationships with key design and materials decision-makers at tier-1 automotive brands.
Pillar 2: Biological Human Interface Technologies for Robotics
Extending from 3D Bio-Tissues' core tissue-engineering capabilities - previously demonstrated through its continuous tissue-scaffolding production workflows - BSF is advancing its technology into the rapidly emerging robotics sector.
As humanoid and specialised robotics progress toward complex industrial and domestic environments, traditional synthetic outer layers present performance limitations. BSF's platform enables the production of bio-engineered human skin equivalents-advanced biological surface layers designed to provide natural flexibility, structural compatibility, and seamless bio-interface integration.
By applying tissue engineering at scale, BSF aims to establish its biological materials as a premier surface interface option for global robotics OEMs seeking advanced biological material integration.
Commercial Milestones
The Heads of Terms establish performance milestones targeting a binding MOU for the development or licensing of Lab-Grown Leather products during September to December 2026 and a binding MOU with a Tier-1 partner for Robotics Skin / Biological Interface development during September 2026 to January 2027.
Executive Commentary
Che Connon, Chief Executive Officer of BSF Enterprise PLC, commented:
"
This strategic partnership represents a significant step in converting our platform science into high-value commercial channels. Entering the ultra-luxury automotive sector gives us direct communication with decision-makers who define luxury craftsmanship, allowing us to commercialise our lab-grown leather in bespoke vehicle programs.
"Simultaneously, extending our tissue-scaffolding technology into biological interface materials for robotics opens a vast new market opportunity. By applying our expertise in bio-engineered human skin equivalents, we are positioning BSF at the intersection of biotechnology and advanced robotics. We have built a commercial framework that protects our IP while giving our partner every incentive to secure major OEM contracts.
"
Nico Schakau, Managing Director of SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH, added:
"
For more than two decades, we have worked at the intersection of engineering, advanced materials and the automotive industry. But some ideas have the potential to reach far beyond the industries in which they begin.
We believe biological materials could fundamentally change the way humans and machines interact. As humanoid robotics becomes part of our everyday world, the interface between human and machine will matter just as much as the intelligence within it. Tissue engineering opens the door to an entirely new generation of biological interfaces - more natural, more adaptive and ultimately more human.
Lab-grown leather gives us an extraordinary opportunity to demonstrate what this technology can achieve today. Robotics gives us a glimpse of what it could become tomorrow."

BSF Enterprise PLC (LSE: BSFA), the biotechnology company focused on developing tissue engineering, lab-grown materials, and bioactive solutions, is pleased to announce that it has executed Heads of Terms establishing a worldwide, exclusive commercialisation and supply partnership for its proprietary bioactive peptide, ETSYL
®
(INCI: palmitoyl pentapeptide-87), with SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH ("SCHAKAU").
Under the terms executed, key provisions including global market exclusivity, 100% intellectual property retention, and confidentiality are legally binding upon signature. SCHAKAU has been granted exclusive global commercialisation, distribution, and licensing rights for ETSYL
®
across the cosmetics, skincare, dermocosmetics, and luxury beauty sectors for an initial target-linked term of 10 years.
Key Transaction Highlights:
●
Exclusive 10-Year Global Term:
SCHAKAU receives exclusive worldwide rights in cosmetics and luxury beauty for an initial 10-year period, strictly conditional upon achieving agreed annual commercial volume targets following an initial 12-month ramp-up period.
●
Funded Commercialisation:
SCHAKAU has allocated a dedicated market development budget estimated at
€300,000
to fund clinical claim substantiation, regulatory compliance, brand creation, and international distribution capital.
●
Downstream Expenses:
SCHAKAU is solely responsible, at its own expense, for all finished consumer product notifications (including CPNP/SCPN portal filings), Cosmetic Product Safety Reports (CPSR), Responsible Person (RP) representations, and clinical efficacy testing.
●
Direct Supply Revenue Stream & Expected Timing:
BSF will supply compliant bioactive ETSYL® under a structured, dose-based volume schedule, securing commercial manufacturing margins for BSF's 100% subsidiary, 3D Bio-tissues Ltd. Initial raw material supply revenues are expected during the 12-month product compilation phase ahead of retail launch.
●
50:50 Third-Party Licensing Split:
Net licensing income from third-party brand integrations will be split 50:50, after deducting external compliance and international patent prosecution and maintenance costs, directly protecting BSF's historical and ongoing patent investments.
●
100% IP Retention:
BSF retains absolute ownership of all patents, trade secrets, manufacturing know-how, and underlying technology related to ETSYL
®
.
Background on ETSYL®: Unlocking Portfolio Value in Cosmetics
ETSYL
®
(palmitoyl pentapeptide-87) represents a high-value commercial derivative from BSF's core tissue engineering R&D program. Originally developed in-house by BSF's 100% subsidiary, 3D Bio-tissues Ltd, to accelerate cell growth and stimulate natural collagen synthesis within tissue scaffolding for lab-grown products, the bioactive peptide demonstrated high biological activity in extracellular matrix production.
Recognising the growing global market demand for scientific, clinically backed bioactive peptides in high-end anti-ageing cosmetics, BSF identified ETSYL
®
as a high-margin commercial spin-off. By leveraging 3D Bio-tissues' proprietary bio-manufacturing workflows, BSF can produce ETSYL
®
at scale, serving as a raw bioactive supplier to the skincare market without diverting capital from its core tissue engineering and leather applications.
Partner Profile: SCHAKAU & The HANDS OF GOD Ecosystem
SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH, led by founder Nico Schakau, is a boutique commercialisation firm specialising in brand scaling, luxury positioning, and high-value industrial partnerships. SCHAKAU leads market development, brand creation, and global commercialisation within the luxury beauty and dermocosmetics space.
SCHAKAU is deploying ETSYL
®
as the core active ingredient in its flagship ultra-luxury skincare brand, HANDS OF GOD, featuring a high-potency skin serum ("E-L-Y-S-Y-L"). Under the partnership, SCHAKAU will drive both direct consumer product deployment via HANDS OF GOD and broader B2B ingredient licensing to global cosmetic brand partners.
Executive Commentary
Che Connon, Chief Executive Officer of BSF Enterprise PLC, commented:
"ETSYL® is a prime example of the deep value embedded across BSF's biotechnology portfolio. Originally engineered by our team at 3D Bio-tissues to boost natural collagen generation for our lab-grown tissue structures, its ability to stimulate skin cell matrix production made its application in luxury skincare an excellent added commercial bonus.
By partnering with Nico and the team at SCHAKAU, we have established a capital-light, highly scalable model. SCHAKAU is funding downstream clinical, regulatory, and brand launch costs, allowing BSF to capture manufacturing supply revenues and 50% of global licensing income, while retaining 100% ownership of our core patent stack. This transaction validates our strategy of converting platform science into non-dilutive commercial cash flows."
Nico Schakau, Managing Director of SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH, added:
"We are delighted to enter into this long-term global partnership with BSF Enterprise PLC. We firmly believe in the long-term and sustainable growth of the longevity sector, and that the next generation of luxury skincare will be defined not simply by branding, but by science, measurable efficacy and truly differentiated bioactive technologies. ETSYL® embodies precisely that ambition. Beginning with HANDS OF GOD, we intend to establish ETSYL® as a globally recognised ingredient hallmark for advanced bioactive skincare and to build an international commercial ecosystem around the technology over the coming decade.
Our ambition is simple: turn exceptional science into a global icon.

Heads of Terms Executed for US Joint Venture
& High-Profile US Event Launch for T-Rex Leather™
BSF Enterprise PLC (LSE: BSFA), the tissue engineering company, is pleased to announce that it has entered into a non-binding Heads of Terms ("HoT") with US-based brand operator IMPOSTER LLC ("IMPOSTER") to establish a Joint Venture Company ("JVCO"). The proposed partnership provides a capital-efficient, de-risked route for BSF to commercialise its proprietary T-Rex Leather™ in the lucrative North American luxury market, while fully preserving the Company's independent commercial rights across primary global volume categories.
Key Highlights:
●
US Market Entry & Event Activation:
Enables immediate Phase 1 marketing, showcasing and customer pre-orders for T-Rex Leather™ goods across premier US high-net-worth events, including the Hampton Classic Horse Show (August 2026), New York Fashion Week (September 2026) and the Humane World Gala (November 2026).
●
Defined Commercial Scope:
JVCO will focus exclusively on small luxury novelty goods, bag charms, keyrings, desk accessories, equestrian sporting goods and a limited showcase run of bespoke handbags and wallets.
●
Retention of Core Commercial Rights and IP:
BSF retains 100% of all IP, commercial and distribution rights for high-volume categories, including mainline footwear, apparel, automotive interiors and mass-market handbags, preserving complete freedom to execute independent partnerships with global Tier 1 luxury houses.
●
Zero Cash Capital Contribution from BSF:
BSF will contribute core technology licensing and material supply access but zero cash capital to JVCO. Full Phase 2 commercial operation and product exclusivity are strictly conditional on IMPOSTER successfully providing ring-fenced operational funding of $500,000 to $1,000,000 to JVCO (drawn from IMPOSTER's planned $3.5 million growth capital raise).
●
Multi-Stream Revenue Generation:
BSF targets multi-stream cash generation, including a contemplated 25%-35% gross margin on raw T-Rex Leather™ material transfers, an anticipated ingredient royalty of 3%-7% on net sales and a 50% share of downstream JV profits.
●
Proven US Luxury & Event Leadership:
JVCO will be led by Jaclyn Sharp as CEO, alongside Valerie Angeli overseeing US Operations & Event Strategy and Simon Whitehouse as Strategic Luxury Adviser. This team brings deep North American networks across luxury retail, high-net-worth equestrian circuits, and ethical brand activations.
Phased Activation & Targeted US Marketing
Under the terms of the agreement, BSF (via its wholly owned subsidiary, Lab-Grown Leather Ltd) and IMPOSTER will form a 50/50 joint venture entity. To capture near term commercial momentum, the agreement establishes a two-phase rollout:
1.
Phase 1 (Immediate Activation):
Grants JVCO a targeted marketing and event license to deploy T-Rex Leather™ showcase items at major US luxury activations starting in August 2026. This initiative targets ultra-high-net-worth consumers, equestrian lifestyle markets and ethical luxury buyers in North America.
2.
Phase 2 (Full Exclusivity Activation):
Full commercial category exclusivity will activate upon IMPOSTER closing its broader growth financing and transferring dedicated ring-fenced operational funding into JVCO.
Retained Intellectual Property & Supply Terms
BSF retains 100% ownership of all underlying patents, scaffold workflows and core cellular technology. BSF will act as the exclusive material supplier to JVCO under a cost-plus model (25%-35% gross margin), ensuring manufacturing cash flows to BSF independent of downstream JV profitability. All finished goods will carry the mandatory hallmark
"Crafted with T-Rex Leather™"
to build brand equity in North America.
Dedicated US Management & Commercial Execution
The JVCO board and executive team bring extensive domain expertise to accelerate market entry in North America. Under the leadership of
Jaclyn Sharp (CEO), Valerie Angeli (Director of US Operations & Event Strategy), and Simon Whitehouse (Strategic Luxury Adviser),
JVCO gains immediate access to established networks in luxury fashion, high-net-worth equestrian sports and animal welfare organizations to drive commercial pull-through for T-Rex Leather™. IMPOSTER LLC brings dedicated brand building capability, deep ethical-luxury positioning, and established relationships across US animal welfare organisations and luxury retail channels. Partnering with IMPOSTER provides BSF with immediate operational firepower and targeted market access in North America without diluting BSF's internal management focus on core technology scaling.
Che Connon, Chief Executive Officer of BSF Enterprise, commented:
"This agreement represents an exciting step forward in our strategy to build commercial traction in the lucrative North American market. Partnering with IMPOSTER gives us an immediate, funded platform to showcase T-Rex Leather™ directly to high-net-worth individuals and luxury buyers at events like the Hampton Classic and New York Fashion Week - without committing BSF cash capital. Crucially, by limiting the JV scope to targeted luxury accessories, we preserve total freedom to execute direct commercial deals with major global fashion and automotive brands across our primary categories."
Jaclyn Sharp, Founder & CEO of IMPOSTER, commented:
"T-Rex Leather™ represents exactly the kind of material innovation that IMPOSTER was built to champion - proof that luxury no longer requires compromise. Partnering with BSF gives us the opportunity to bring the world's most extraordinary bio-fabricated material to the US luxury market at a moment when the industry is actively searching for what comes next. We're proud to help lead that shift."
Transaction Conditionality Disclaimer
The proposed Joint Venture remains subject to completion of mutual due diligence, execution of definitive legally binding documentation, satisfaction of funding conditions precedent, and customary board and regulatory approvals. Further updates will be provided to the market as definitive agreements are finalised.

Application will be made for the Conversion Shares to be admitted to the Equity Shares (transition) category of the Official List and to trading on the London Stock Exchange's main market for listed securities ("Admission"). Admission is expected to become effective and dealings in the Conversion Shares to commence at 8.00 a.m. on 28 August 2026.
The Conversion Shares will rank pari passu in all respects with the Company's existing ordinary shares.

Lab-Grown Leather for Ultra-Luxury Automotive & Advanced Robotics Skin
BSF Enterprise Plc (LSE: BSFA), (OTCQB: BSFAF), the biotechnology company focused on tissue engineering, lab-grown materials and bioactive solutions, is pleased to announce that it has executed a Heads of Terms where certain provisions are legally binding, establishing a Strategic Partnership with SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH ("SCHAKAU").
The partnership establishes a targeted commercial framework focused on two high-value growth pillars:
1. Luxury Automotive & Bespoke Materials: Rapid commercialisation of BSF's Lab-Grown Leather portfolio (including the T-Rex Leather™ concept) across bespoke, ultra-luxury programs with leading European automotive manufacturers.
2. Robotics Skin & Biological Human Interface Technologies: Industrial adoption of BSF's bio-engineered human skin equivalents and biological interface materials for humanoid and industrial robotics applications.
Key Highlights:
●
Direct Access to Leading European Luxury Automotive OEMs and Tier-1 Decision-Makers:
Establishes direct commercial conduits into ultra luxury vehicle manufacturers and specialised automotive engineering programs, targeting immediate 1-of-1 bespoke interior accents and trim applications.
●
Next-Generation Robotics Interfaces:
Leverages 3D Bio-Tissues' proprietary tissue-scaffolding technology to supply bio-engineered human skin equivalents as biological surface layers for humanoid and industrial robotic systems.
●
Performance-Aligned 6-Year Commercial Model:
The agreed commercial framework provides for a revenue share on SCHAKAU-originated programmes. Pre-SOP commercial revenues participate in the revenue share upon receipt but do not commence the six-year period.
Following First Commercial Production, the baseline revenue-share percentage per program (as agreed at that time) applies in full for Years 1-3, reducing to 50% of that percentage for Years 4-6, after which the revenue share ceases.
●
Performance-Based Equity Incentives:
The commercial framework contemplates a milestone-based equity and option programme, with any option or warrant vesting being 100% performance-contingent against defined commercial milestones
●
Strategic Capital Introduction Framework:
Capital introduced by SCHAKAU attracts a success fee of 5% up to £10m, 4% from £10m-£25m, 3% from £25m-£50m and 2% above £50m, payable in cash or equity on completion.
●
100% IP Ownership Retained
: BSF (via subsidiaries 3D Bio-Tissues Ltd and Lab-Grown Leather Ltd) retains absolute, 100% ownership of all underlying patents, scaffolds, trade secrets, and cell-manufacturing workflows.
●
Opportunity-Specific Exclusivity:
SCHAKAU will have exclusivity in respect of commercial opportunities introduced by it and acknowledged or deemed acknowledged under the Heads of Terms, subject to agreed protections for BSF's pre-existing relationships and an inactivity mechanism allowing BSF to withdraw exclusivity from a specific target following 180 consecutive days without substantive commercial interaction.
Pillar 1: Luxury Automotive & OEM Expansion
Through SCHAKAU's established industry network, BSF is positioning its Lab-Grown Leather (LGL) platform directly within the ultra-premium automotive sector. Initial commercialisation will focus on high-margin, bespoke interior trim, steering elements, and luxury accents (under BSF's proprietary T-Rex Leather™ hallmark).
This bespoke approach enables BSF to generate early commercial traction and high-margin product revenue without requiring immediate large-scale industrial manufacturing infrastructure, while establishing direct relationships with key design and materials decision-makers at tier-1 automotive brands.
Pillar 2: Biological Human Interface Technologies for Robotics
Extending from 3D Bio-Tissues' core tissue-engineering capabilities - previously demonstrated through its continuous tissue-scaffolding production workflows - BSF is advancing its technology into the rapidly emerging robotics sector.
As humanoid and specialised robotics progress toward complex industrial and domestic environments, traditional synthetic outer layers present performance limitations. BSF's platform enables the production of bio-engineered human skin equivalents-advanced biological surface layers designed to provide natural flexibility, structural compatibility, and seamless bio-interface integration.
By applying tissue engineering at scale, BSF aims to establish its biological materials as a premier surface interface option for global robotics OEMs seeking advanced biological material integration.
Commercial Milestones
The Heads of Terms establish performance milestones targeting a binding MOU for the development or licensing of Lab-Grown Leather products during September to December 2026 and a binding MOU with a Tier-1 partner for Robotics Skin / Biological Interface development during September 2026 to January 2027.
Executive Commentary
Che Connon, Chief Executive Officer of BSF Enterprise PLC, commented:
"
This strategic partnership represents a significant step in converting our platform science into high-value commercial channels. Entering the ultra-luxury automotive sector gives us direct communication with decision-makers who define luxury craftsmanship, allowing us to commercialise our lab-grown leather in bespoke vehicle programs.
"Simultaneously, extending our tissue-scaffolding technology into biological interface materials for robotics opens a vast new market opportunity. By applying our expertise in bio-engineered human skin equivalents, we are positioning BSF at the intersection of biotechnology and advanced robotics. We have built a commercial framework that protects our IP while giving our partner every incentive to secure major OEM contracts.
"
Nico Schakau, Managing Director of SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH, added:
"
For more than two decades, we have worked at the intersection of engineering, advanced materials and the automotive industry. But some ideas have the potential to reach far beyond the industries in which they begin.
We believe biological materials could fundamentally change the way humans and machines interact. As humanoid robotics becomes part of our everyday world, the interface between human and machine will matter just as much as the intelligence within it. Tissue engineering opens the door to an entirely new generation of biological interfaces - more natural, more adaptive and ultimately more human.
Lab-grown leather gives us an extraordinary opportunity to demonstrate what this technology can achieve today. Robotics gives us a glimpse of what it could become tomorrow."

Worldwide Exclusive Commercialisation of ETSYL
®
in Luxury Cosmetics & Skincare
BSF Enterprise PLC (LSE: BSFA), the biotechnology company focused on developing tissue engineering, lab-grown materials, and bioactive solutions, is pleased to announce that it has executed Heads of Terms establishing a worldwide, exclusive commercialisation and supply partnership for its proprietary bioactive peptide, ETSYL
®
(INCI: palmitoyl pentapeptide-87), with SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH ("SCHAKAU").
Under the terms executed, key provisions including global market exclusivity, 100% intellectual property retention, and confidentiality are legally binding upon signature. SCHAKAU has been granted exclusive global commercialisation, distribution, and licensing rights for ETSYL
®
across the cosmetics, skincare, dermocosmetics, and luxury beauty sectors for an initial target-linked term of 10 years.
Key Transaction Highlights:
●
Exclusive 10-Year Global Term:
SCHAKAU receives exclusive worldwide rights in cosmetics and luxury beauty for an initial 10-year period, strictly conditional upon achieving agreed annual commercial volume targets following an initial 12-month ramp-up period.
●
Funded Commercialisation:
SCHAKAU has allocated a dedicated market development budget estimated at
€300,000
to fund clinical claim substantiation, regulatory compliance, brand creation, and international distribution capital.
●
Downstream Expenses:
SCHAKAU is solely responsible, at its own expense, for all finished consumer product notifications (including CPNP/SCPN portal filings), Cosmetic Product Safety Reports (CPSR), Responsible Person (RP) representations, and clinical efficacy testing.
●
Direct Supply Revenue Stream & Expected Timing:
BSF will supply compliant bioactive ETSYL® under a structured, dose-based volume schedule, securing commercial manufacturing margins for BSF's 100% subsidiary, 3D Bio-tissues Ltd. Initial raw material supply revenues are expected during the 12-month product compilation phase ahead of retail launch.
●
50:50 Third-Party Licensing Split:
Net licensing income from third-party brand integrations will be split 50:50, after deducting external compliance and international patent prosecution and maintenance costs, directly protecting BSF's historical and ongoing patent investments.
●
100% IP Retention:
BSF retains absolute ownership of all patents, trade secrets, manufacturing know-how, and underlying technology related to ETSYL
®
.
Background on ETSYL®: Unlocking Portfolio Value in Cosmetics
ETSYL
®
(palmitoyl pentapeptide-87) represents a high-value commercial derivative from BSF's core tissue engineering R&D program. Originally developed in-house by BSF's 100% subsidiary, 3D Bio-tissues Ltd, to accelerate cell growth and stimulate natural collagen synthesis within tissue scaffolding for lab-grown products, the bioactive peptide demonstrated high biological activity in extracellular matrix production.
Recognising the growing global market demand for scientific, clinically backed bioactive peptides in high-end anti-ageing cosmetics, BSF identified ETSYL
®
as a high-margin commercial spin-off. By leveraging 3D Bio-tissues' proprietary bio-manufacturing workflows, BSF can produce ETSYL
®
at scale, serving as a raw bioactive supplier to the skincare market without diverting capital from its core tissue engineering and leather applications.
Partner Profile: SCHAKAU & The HANDS OF GOD Ecosystem
SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH, led by founder Nico Schakau, is a boutique commercialisation firm specialising in brand scaling, luxury positioning, and high-value industrial partnerships. SCHAKAU leads market development, brand creation, and global commercialisation within the luxury beauty and dermocosmetics space.
SCHAKAU is deploying ETSYL
®
as the core active ingredient in its flagship ultra-luxury skincare brand, HANDS OF GOD, featuring a high-potency skin serum ("E-L-Y-S-Y-L"). Under the partnership, SCHAKAU will drive both direct consumer product deployment via HANDS OF GOD and broader B2B ingredient licensing to global cosmetic brand partners.
Executive Commentary
Che Connon, Chief Executive Officer of BSF Enterprise PLC, commented:
"ETSYL® is a prime example of the deep value embedded across BSF's biotechnology portfolio. Originally engineered by our team at 3D Bio-tissues to boost natural collagen generation for our lab-grown tissue structures, its ability to stimulate skin cell matrix production made its application in luxury skincare an excellent added commercial bonus.
By partnering with Nico and the team at SCHAKAU, we have established a capital-light, highly scalable model. SCHAKAU is funding downstream clinical, regulatory, and brand launch costs, allowing BSF to capture manufacturing supply revenues and 50% of global licensing income, while retaining 100% ownership of our core patent stack. This transaction validates our strategy of converting platform science into non-dilutive commercial cash flows."
Nico Schakau, Managing Director of SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH, added:
"We are delighted to enter into this long-term global partnership with BSF Enterprise PLC. We firmly believe in the long-term and sustainable growth of the longevity sector, and that the next generation of luxury skincare will be defined not simply by branding, but by science, measurable efficacy and truly differentiated bioactive technologies. ETSYL® embodies precisely that ambition. Beginning with HANDS OF GOD, we intend to establish ETSYL® as a globally recognised ingredient hallmark for advanced bioactive skincare and to build an international commercial ecosystem around the technology over the coming decade.
Our ambition is simple: turn exceptional science into a global icon.

Heads of Terms Executed for US Joint Venture
& High-Profile US Event Launch for T-Rex Leather™
BSF Enterprise PLC (LSE: BSFA), the tissue engineering company, is pleased to announce that it has entered into a non-binding Heads of Terms ("HoT") with US-based brand operator IMPOSTER LLC ("IMPOSTER") to establish a Joint Venture Company ("JVCO"). The proposed partnership provides a capital-efficient, de-risked route for BSF to commercialise its proprietary T-Rex Leather™ in the lucrative North American luxury market, while fully preserving the Company's independent commercial rights across primary global volume categories.
Key Highlights:
●
US Market Entry & Event Activation:
Enables immediate Phase 1 marketing, showcasing and customer pre-orders for T-Rex Leather™ goods across premier US high-net-worth events, including the Hampton Classic Horse Show (August 2026), New York Fashion Week (September 2026) and the Humane World Gala (November 2026).
●
Defined Commercial Scope:
JVCO will focus exclusively on small luxury novelty goods, bag charms, keyrings, desk accessories, equestrian sporting goods and a limited showcase run of bespoke handbags and wallets.
●
Retention of Core Commercial Rights and IP:
BSF retains 100% of all IP, commercial and distribution rights for high-volume categories, including mainline footwear, apparel, automotive interiors and mass-market handbags, preserving complete freedom to execute independent partnerships with global Tier 1 luxury houses.
●
Zero Cash Capital Contribution from BSF:
BSF will contribute core technology licensing and material supply access but zero cash capital to JVCO. Full Phase 2 commercial operation and product exclusivity are strictly conditional on IMPOSTER successfully providing ring-fenced operational funding of $500,000 to $1,000,000 to JVCO (drawn from IMPOSTER's planned $3.5 million growth capital raise).
●
Multi-Stream Revenue Generation:
BSF targets multi-stream cash generation, including a contemplated 25%-35% gross margin on raw T-Rex Leather™ material transfers, an anticipated ingredient royalty of 3%-7% on net sales and a 50% share of downstream JV profits.
●
Proven US Luxury & Event Leadership:
JVCO will be led by Jaclyn Sharp as CEO, alongside Valerie Angeli overseeing US Operations & Event Strategy and Simon Whitehouse as Strategic Luxury Adviser. This team brings deep North American networks across luxury retail, high-net-worth equestrian circuits, and ethical brand activations.
Phased Activation & Targeted US Marketing
Under the terms of the agreement, BSF (via its wholly owned subsidiary, Lab-Grown Leather Ltd) and IMPOSTER will form a 50/50 joint venture entity. To capture near term commercial momentum, the agreement establishes a two-phase rollout:
1.
Phase 1 (Immediate Activation):
Grants JVCO a targeted marketing and event license to deploy T-Rex Leather™ showcase items at major US luxury activations starting in August 2026. This initiative targets ultra-high-net-worth consumers, equestrian lifestyle markets and ethical luxury buyers in North America.
2.
Phase 2 (Full Exclusivity Activation):
Full commercial category exclusivity will activate upon IMPOSTER closing its broader growth financing and transferring dedicated ring-fenced operational funding into JVCO.
Retained Intellectual Property & Supply Terms
BSF retains 100% ownership of all underlying patents, scaffold workflows and core cellular technology. BSF will act as the exclusive material supplier to JVCO under a cost-plus model (25%-35% gross margin), ensuring manufacturing cash flows to BSF independent of downstream JV profitability. All finished goods will carry the mandatory hallmark
"Crafted with T-Rex Leather™"
to build brand equity in North America.
Dedicated US Management & Commercial Execution
The JVCO board and executive team bring extensive domain expertise to accelerate market entry in North America. Under the leadership of
Jaclyn Sharp (CEO), Valerie Angeli (Director of US Operations & Event Strategy), and Simon Whitehouse (Strategic Luxury Adviser),
JVCO gains immediate access to established networks in luxury fashion, high-net-worth equestrian sports and animal welfare organizations to drive commercial pull-through for T-Rex Leather™. IMPOSTER LLC brings dedicated brand building capability, deep ethical-luxury positioning, and established relationships across US animal welfare organisations and luxury retail channels. Partnering with IMPOSTER provides BSF with immediate operational firepower and targeted market access in North America without diluting BSF's internal management focus on core technology scaling.
Che Connon, Chief Executive Officer of BSF Enterprise, commented:
"This agreement represents an exciting step forward in our strategy to build commercial traction in the lucrative North American market. Partnering with IMPOSTER gives us an immediate, funded platform to showcase T-Rex Leather™ directly to high-net-worth individuals and luxury buyers at events like the Hampton Classic and New York Fashion Week - without committing BSF cash capital. Crucially, by limiting the JV scope to targeted luxury accessories, we preserve total freedom to execute direct commercial deals with major global fashion and automotive brands across our primary categories."
Jaclyn Sharp, Founder & CEO of IMPOSTER, commented:
"T-Rex Leather™ represents exactly the kind of material innovation that IMPOSTER was built to champion - proof that luxury no longer requires compromise. Partnering with BSF gives us the opportunity to bring the world's most extraordinary bio-fabricated material to the US luxury market at a moment when the industry is actively searching for what comes next. We're proud to help lead that shift."
Transaction Conditionality Disclaimer
The proposed Joint Venture remains subject to completion of mutual due diligence, execution of definitive legally binding documentation, satisfaction of funding conditions precedent, and customary board and regulatory approvals. Further updates will be provided to the market as definitive agreements are finalised.

s Statement
On behalf of the Board, I am pleased to present BSF Enterprise Plc's Interim Results for the six months ended 31 March 2026.
During the period, the Group continued to make important progress across its portfolio companies, advancing strategic partnerships, strengthening commercial engagement and developing technologies that support our long-term objective of becoming a leading innovator in tissue-engineered materials and regenerative medicine
Lab-Grown Leather Ltd ("LGL") continued to make substantial progress towards commercialisation. During the period, development advanced across its three product families: Elemental Leather™
, Elemental+
™
and Elemental X
™. The announcement of Elemental X™ and the Company's pioneering T-Rex leather initiative attracted significant global media attention and generated engagement with potential commercial partners. Following these developments, discussions continued with several internationally recognised fashion and accessories brands regarding future product development and commercial opportunities.
Within 3DBT, development of the CytoBoost™ product range continued to progress positively. Early third-party testing demonstrated encouraging improvements in post-thaw cell recovery and viability, highlighting the potential commercial value of the technology within cell therapy, regenerative medicine and cultivated meat production. Further commercial deals with cultivated meat companies for the supply of City mix such as with South Korean cultivated meat company Seawith.
Kerato Ltd also continued to advance its LiQD Cornea programme. During the period, progress was made in relation to grant-supported development activities, regulatory planning and implementation of an ISO 13485 quality management framework.
The Board remained focused on securing appropriate funding to support the Group's strategic objectives. During the period the Company secured additional financing through a convertible loan note, providing working capital to continue development activities across the portfolio. Also subsequent to the period we secured further private placements of funds allowing the Company a solid financial platform to enable growth through 2026 and into 2027.
Intellectual property remains central to the Group's value creation strategy. Across our subsidiaries we continue to strengthen and protect our portfolio of patents, proprietary processes, trademarks and know-how.
While the Group remains in an investment and development phase, the progress achieved during the six-month period demonstrates increasing commercial engagement, continued technology validation and growing recognition of the potential value of our innovations.
On behalf of the Board, I would like to thank our shareholders, employees, scientific collaborators and commercial partners for their continued support and confidence.
Geoff Baker
Chairman
BSF Enterprise PLC
Chief Executive
'
s Report
I am pleased to present my report for the six months ended 31 March 2026.
Overview
During the six months ended 31 March 2026, BSF Enterprise PLC ("BSF" or the "Company") successfully shifted its core strategic focus from intensive Research and Development (R&D) toward aggressive commercialisation and clinical execution. Operating via its three high-growth, wholly-owned subsidiaries - 3D Bio-Tissues Ltd (3DBT), Kerato Ltd, and Lab-Grown Leather Ltd (LGL) - the Company has unlocked multiple commercial pathways, initiated key trial phases, and developed an asset-backed, anti-dilutive corporate structure to maximize shareholder value.
Financial Summary
●
Net Loss:
The net loss for the period ended 31 March 2026 was £956,625 (compared to a loss of £790,623 for the corresponding six-month period in 2025). This widening reflects higher legal and professional fees (including expenses related to a proposed fundraising process), costs associated with our corneal development collaboration with the Universit
é
de Montr
é
al, and a higher level of consumables used to accelerate lab-grown leather development. Furthermore, no grant income was recognised during this half-year, compared to £67,823 in the same period last year.
●
Loss Per Share
: The basic and diluted loss per share increased from 0.64 pence to 0.75 pence.
Cash Flow & Funding
1.
Cash Position:
The Group
'
s cash balance as of 31 March 2026 stood at
£60,174
, compared with £149,020 at 30 September 2025.
2.
Interim Inflows:
The cash reduction from operational losses was successfully mitigated by careful working capital management and the receipt of £300,000 in December 2025 via an interest-free convertible loan note (CLN). While the broader proposed £15m funding package was mutually terminated in March 2026, this £300,000 CLN has been extended for 12 months, holding cash repayment terms or conversion rights at the next capital raise.
3.
Post-Period Capitalisation (April 2026):
Immediately following the period-end on 2 April 2026, the Group significantly bolstered its liquidity by raising £385,000 (before expenses) through the placement of 38,500,000 new ordinary shares at 1p per share, alongside matching warrants. Subsequent conditional financings in June 2026 further reinforced this trajectory with an additional £500,000 placement and a £
1,000,000 Indigo Capital CLN).
4.
Dividends:
No dividends were paid or proposed during the period.
Business Review
Strategic Partnerships and Collaborations
BSF has built out its collaborative ecosystem across its subsidiary portfolio to capture distinct global markets. Most notably, 3DBT secured a milestone supply and technical agreement with South Korean company, Seawith, generating a robust initial commercial pipeline valued at £500,000. Cultivated meat partnerships and biopharma client footprints have scaled significantly through the first half of 2026, anchoring BSF as a critical supplier within the global bio-based materials and cellular agriculture sectors.
Advancements in Lab-Grown Leather Commercialisation
Through Lab-Grown Leather Ltd (LGL), the Company achieved strong validation of its proprietary tissue engineering technology. LGL successfully synthesized T-Rex Leather™, a high-end, sustainable luxury leather alternative grown from synthetic dinosaur DNA. This breakthrough leverages BSF
'
s signature ATEP™ (Alternative Tissue Engineering Platform) scaffold-free manufacturing system. A fully tanned T-Rex leather skin has been completed, signalling LGL's transition from speculative science into a viable luxury-market material supplier.
Breakthrough Developments and Market Engagement
Market engagement for the period was highlighted by high-profile luxury branding and public activations. LGL collaborated with a premier Berlin-based designer to manufacture a world-first luxury avant-garde handbag utilising the T-Rex Leather™ skin. This landmark piece is scheduled for high-visibility market entry, backed by global PR and marketing execution via VML.
Concurrently, Kerato Ltd achieved the midpoint of its developmental milestone for LiQD Cornea™, a biosynthetic hydrogel device designed for single-handed administration to treat corneal damage without donor tissue, directly targeting the massive global corneal transplant market.
Financial Developments and Strategic Funding
BSF responded natively to shifting macro environments by optimizing capital efficiency:
●
Capital Realignment:
Following the mutual termination of a proposed £15 million equity fundraise and capital reorganisation, BSF prioritised efficient, low-dilution funding.
●
Convertible Loan Notes (CLN):
The Company extended its £300,000 CLN facility by 12 months, maintainable under identical terms, preserving short-term cash flows with rights to convert at the next major capital raise price.
●
Grant Funding:
Kerato's active Phase 1 trials are highly leveraged, benefiting from 50% funding matching through Canadian government innovation grants.
●
Subsidiary Spin-Out Framework:
To accelerate scaling without diluting parent PLC shareholders, BSF established a "Spin-Out Pathway." Both LGL and Kerato are positioned to raise independent growth capital directly at the subsidiary level following their respective 2026 market catalysts.
Comprehensive IP Strategy: Protecting Innovation and Driving Valuation
The Company's valuation growth remains underpinned by its dual-pronged Intellectual Property (IP) strategy:
-
The ATEP™ Platform:
Maintaining strict proprietary control over the underlying, scaffold-free structural biological platform allows BSF to spawn cross-industry applications (leather, medical devices, cultivated meat) from a single IP foundation.
-
Product-Specific IP:
Trademarks and trade secrets surrounding downstream consumer products - such as T-Rex Leather™
, CytoBoost
™ REVIVE, and LiQD Cornea™ - isolate asset valuations, allowing clean carve-outs during subsidiary-level funding rounds.
Commercial Partnerships and Sample Development
Commercial sales momentum experienced a step-change during the review period:
●
3DBT Product Expansion:
Commercial launch and rapid scaling of CytoBoost™ REVIVE media factors into the biopharmaceutical sector.
●
City-Mix
Ⓡ
Growth:
Significant, consecutive three-month growth in commercial customer orders for City-Mix
Ⓡ
serum-free media supplements within the cultivated meat market.
●
Kerato Distribution Runway:
Kerato has hit critical operational and regulatory milestones, tracking toward formalising veterinary commercial distribution agreements by Q4 2026.
Operational Efficiencies and Sustainability Initiatives
Operationally, BSF
'
s entire business model drives a bio-sustainable future. By leveraging its scaffold-free cellular matrix technology, the group actively reduces heavy chemical reliance typical of traditional leather tanning, addresses severe global shortages in donor corneal tissue, and removes animal-testing models from commercial medical research. BSF Enterprise PLC (LSE: BSFA; OTCQB: BSFAF), a biotech platform company driving an industrial bio-sustainable future through its advanced tissue engineering subsidiaries, provides an operational update and commercial clarification following the public auction of the world
'
s first T-Rex Leather

handbag at the H
ô

é

'

150,000, falling short of the historical reserve price. The piece has been withdrawn from public auction and is transitioning to a private sale process targeting parties that expressed interest at the auction, institutional collectors, museums, and high-net-worth individuals.
●
Acceleration of Tier-1 Commercial Dialogues:
The high global visibility of the Paris exhibition has generated an acceleration of inbound interest from multi-billion-dollar enterprise partners, specifically across global automotive interiors and premium performance sportswear brands evaluating material integration.

).
A System Validation, Not an End-Consumer Asset
The Board notes that recent market sentiment surrounding the public auction has conflated a specialised, museum-grade technical demonstration with the Company's broader commercial output. The primary objective of the T-Rex Leather
™
project was never to establish BSF as a consumer fashion retailer, but rather to subject our scaffold-free, computational biology platform to the most extreme manufacturing stress-test possible.
To successfully construct a high-performance luxury asset requiring deep structural density, complex stitching, and industrial tanning from synthesized, extinct DNA sequences represents total proof-of-concept validation for our engineering biology systems.
Commercial Inbound & Platform Scale
While public auction bidding closed at
€
150,000, the visibility generated has significantly de-risked our material science vertical. BSF is currently advancing technical evaluations with major international corporations, including:
1.
A Global Sportswear Leader:
Steps towards evaluating the performance and branding characteristics of our ATEP
™
sheets for next-generation performance footwear applications.
2.
A Tier-1 Automotive Manufacturer:
Discussing technical feasibility studies on the scalability of our bio-synthetic hide for bespoke, sustainable vehicle upholstery.
Crucially, our underlying business model for LGL relies on eventual high-volume industrial supply, licensing agreements, and the sale of automated bioreactor infrastructure to these mass-market verticals, rather than the sale of one artisan luxury accessory.
Strong Balance Sheet and Multi-Asset Insulation
Supported by our recently announced
£
1 Million interest-free Convertible Loan Note with Indigo Capital, BSF remains thoroughly funded to scale operations across our three distinct, high-growth subsidiaries without placing reliance on single-product events:
●
Lab-Grown Leather (LGL):
Capitalising on our newly achieved A4-sized tannable skin milestones and active B2B corporate assessment pipelines.
●
3D Bio-Tissues (3DBT):
Scaling commercial supply agreements for our cellular nutrition enhancers (City-Mix
™
and CytoBoost
™
Revive) with international partners like SeaWith, driving near-term commercial revenue.
●
Kerato Limited:
Progressing toward veterinary and clinical safety targets for our tissue-engineered corneal repair solutions, capturing a vital footprint in the advanced MedTech space.
The Board is confident that our multi-pillar structure limits risk while multiplying value-inflection milestones, ensuring parent PLC shareholders remain exposed to an expansive industrial IP engine rather than a single consumer luxury asset.
Dr. Che Connon, CEO of BSF Enterprise, commented:
"The Paris auction was a public display of an incredible engineering feat: turning abstract, ancient genetic information into a dense, beautifully structured, physical material via our scaffold-free platform. While the public auction bidding didn't meet our historic reserve, the commercial validation we required has been emphatically achieved. The multi-billion-dollar automotive and footwear giants currently considering our materials aren't interested in buying a handbag at auction; they are interested in licensing the platform architecture that created it. BSF is treating biology as software, and our industrial trajectory remains firmly on track."

Indigo
") pursuant to which Indigo has committed to provide £1,000,000 of funding to the Company.
The CLN provides additional working capital to support the Company's ongoing commercial activities and product development programmes.
Key Terms
The principal terms of the CLN are as follows:
●
Total amount of £1,000,000
●
12-month term from the date of issue
●
Zero coupon
●
Conversion price equal to 85% of the lowest five-day VWAP immediately preceding the relevant conversion notice
●
Indigo may convert amounts funded under the CLN into ordinary shares of the Company
●
Any unconverted balance will be converted at maturity, subject to
customary
restrictions
●
The Company may elect to redeem any outstanding CLN at 125% of its nominal value
The CLN contains additional terms and conditions customary for a financing of this nature.
Warrants
Pursuant to the terms of the CLN, Indigo will be entitled to acquire warrants over 9,803,921 ordinary shares in the Company (the "
Indigo Warrants
").
The Indigo Warrants will be exercisable for a period of two years and will have an exercise price equal to 3.57 pence, being a 50% premium to the Company's closing share price at the date of the CLN.
In connection with the CLN, the Company has agreed to issue warrants to Bowsprit Partners in consideration for services provided in relation to the transaction (the "
Broker Warrants
").
The Company will issue 2,526,316 Broker Warrants, each warrant entitling the holder to subscribe for one new ordinary share in the Company at an exercise price of 2.375 pence per share.
The Broker Warrants shall be exercisable at any time during the period of 3 years from the date of issue.
Any issuance of ordinary shares pursuant to the Indigo Warrants or Broker Warrants will be subject to the availability of sufficient shareholder authorities and, where required, admission of the resulting shares to listing on the Equity Shares (Transition) category of the Official List and to trading on the London Stock Exchange's Main Market for listed securities.

"
The Board is pleased to have secured this funding commitment from Indigo. The facility provides additional working capital and financial flexibility as we continue to develop our commercial opportunities across the Company's tissue-engineered product portfolio
."

BSF Enterprise PLC
Publication of Technical White Paper on T-Rex Leather™
BSF Enterprise PLC ("BSF" or the "Company"), a biotech platform company driving a bio-sustainable future , is pleased to announce that its subsidiary, Lab-Grown Leather Ltd ("LGL") , has published a comprehensive technical white paper titled "Facts Behind T-Rex Leather™". Link to paper can be found here:
https://bsfenterprise.com/research
The document details the foundational engineering biology, structural performance benefits, and luxury sector market potential of the company's proprietary T-Rex Leather™ product line. Authored by BSF Enterprise's Chief Scientific Officer Dr. Ricardo Gouveia, PhD - a leading biochemist with over 50 peer-reviewed publications and 30 patents - the publication highlights how BSF's underlying platform technology is successfully scaling beyond medical applications into highly disruptive, zero-waste premium materials.
The key commercial drivers to this bio-material engineering milestone include:
1. Recreation of T-Rex Collagen:
●
The T-Rex Leather™ project began with the isolation of soft tissue from 68-million-year-old T. rex fossils. Only fragments of the collagen protein were recovered, so advanced AI-powered protein modeling was used to reconstruct the full sequence, resulting in a version called Gen4-3. This sequence had enhanced structural features, such as higher lysine content for stronger protein bonds.
●
The reconstructed protein sequence was converted into DNA, optimized, and inserted into animal cell lines to express functional T-Rex collagen.
2. Scaffold-Free Tissue Engineering:
●
Using LGL's proprietary Advanced Tissue Engineering Platform (ATEP™), the team cultivated skin tissue from cells expressing T-Rex collagen. Unlike other methods, this process is scaffold-free, meaning no synthetic or animal-derived scaffolds are used. Instead, cells grow in a crowded liquid medium that mimics natural conditions, resulting in a dense, authentic skin matrix.
●
This approach allows for the production of skin tissues of any size or thickness within weeks, using sustainable, non-toxic tanning methods. The resulting T-Rex Leather™ is strong, customisable, and environmentally friendly.
3. Industrial Scaling and Business Model:
●
The ATEP™ platform offers cost and efficiency advantages by reducing the need for expensive growth factors and eliminating the need for scaffolds. This enables LGL to move quickly from boutique production to high-volume supply and licensing agreements.
●
The technology allows for precise tuning of the leather's properties, making it suitable for various luxury and industrial applications.
4. Impact on the Luxury Sector:
●
T-Rex Leather™ challenges traditional luxury paradigms by offering a material that is not a replica but a "resurrected" resource, creating a new narrative of exclusivity.
●
The product is fully biodegradable, cruelty-free, plastic-free, and traceable, addressing both luxury and sustainability demands.
5. Market Positioning:
●
LGL targets the ultra-luxury segment first, using high-margin, exclusive products to fund further development and scaling. This strategy is designed to attract attention from elite brands and facilitate broader commercial adoption.
●
The technology positions LGL to capitalise on the growing global leather and smart textiles markets, offering a sustainable alternative to animal and petrochemical-based materials.
Consequently, the underlying ATEP™ technology (which can be applied to many other forms of cultivated leather) can transition seamlessly from producing bespoke art objects into fulfilling lucrative, high-volume supply agreements across the massive global leather goods and smart textile markets, permanently redefining the industrial reliance on animal agriculture while entirely avoiding the crutch of petrochemical plastics.
The board views the publication of this white paper as a key commercial validation event , demonstrating that BSF's technology is thoroughly validated and operational, and ready to capture substantial value within expanding global verticals.
Ends

BSF Enterprise PLC
Strategic Update May 2026
BSF Enterprise PLC (
"BSF"
or the
"Company"
), a biotech platform company driving a bio-sustainable future through its three high-growth subsidiaries, announces updates to its strategic operations for 1/2-year 2026.
The activities are
structured to accelerate commercialisation with imminent value-inflection milestones across BSF's three subsidiaries -beyond any existing research and development (R&D).
Key Milestones & Near-Term Catalysts
Lab-Grown Leather Ltd (LGL) - Lead Catalyst (June 2026)
●
World-First Product Launch:
LGL has developed
T-Rex Leather™
- high-end leather alternative grown from synthetic dinosaur DNA using BSF's proprietary
ATEP™
scaffold-free tissue manufacturing platform.
●
Paris Auction:
A tanned T-Rex skin has been completed, and a world-first luxury avant-garde handbag has been manufactured by a Berlin-based designer. The item is scheduled to be auctioned on
June 11
at
Dourot,
a leading Paris auction house, supported by a global PR campaign and marketing by VML.
●
Spin-Out Pathway:
Post-catalyst, LGL will seek independent spin-out funding to scale production capacity, allowing it to raise capital at the subsidiary level without diluting BSF parent shareholders.
Kerato Ltd - Clinical Results & Commercialisation (Q3-Q4 2026)
●
LiQD Cornea™ Hydrogel:
Targeting the expanding corneal transplant world market.
●
Veterinary Clinical Trials:
Phase 1 veterinary trials (50% funded by Canadian government grants) commenced in Q1 2026. Kerato has reached the midpoint of its PSO-funded development programme for LiQD Cornea, achieving key technical, regulatory and operational milestones. These include a successful pre-ITA engagement meeting with Health Canada and ongoing implementation of an ISO 13485-compliant quality management system to support future clinical translation activities.
●
Commercial Outlook:
Kerato aims to sign commercial distribution agreements in Q4 2026 , leading to first commercial veterinary sales in early 2027. Applications for human trials with Health Canada are planned for 2026-2027. Similar to LGL, a subsidiary-level self-funding spin-out is planned post-catalyst.
3D Bio-Tissues Ltd (3DBT) - Commercial Momentum (Active Now)
●
Revenue Generation:
Targeting the massive bio-based materials world market. 3DBT has commercially launched its
CytoBoost™ REVIVE
media factor
into biopharma
and
expanded sales of its
City-MixR
product into
cultivated meat sectors.
●
Sales Growth:
3DBT has experienced significant growth in customer orders
over a recent 3-month period.
●
Commercial Pipeline:
Secured a supply agreement with Seawith, yielding an active
£500,000 pipeline
. New cultivated meat partnerships and further biopharma client expansions are progressing through Q2 and Q3 2026.
Strategic Progress
The Board believes
2026
represents a critical time for BSF and its shareholders based on three key pillars:
1.
Progressing from R&D towards Commercialisation
:
T
he Company has made significant progress in translating its research programmes into commercial and clinical-stage activities
. The T-Rex leather exists, Kerato trials are live, and CytoBoost™ is shipping.
2.
Simultaneous Infrastructure Upside:
Unlike single-asset plays, there are three completely distinct high-growth assets simultaneously , distributing risk and multiplying potential upside events.
3.
Anti-Dilutive Spin-Out Structure:
The Board is evaluating potential subsidiary-level financing options, including possible spin-out structures, which may enable future growth capital to be raised at subsidiary level
.
Management Leadership
The execution of these commercial milestones is led by a highly experienced technical and capital markets management team:
●
Dr. Che Connon
(
Managing Director
): International leader in Tissue Engineering with over 100 publications; founder of four previous biotech spin-outs.
●
Geoff Baker (Executive Director):
Qualified lawyer (Australia & Hong Kong) with an extensive track record commercialising biomedical and industrial innovations.
●
Graham Duncan (CFO):
Chartered Accountant with more than 20 years of capital markets experience, holding an ICAEW Corporate Finance Diploma.
●
Ricardo Gouveia (CSO):
Bioengineering and biochemistry specialist with 20 years of dedicated research in stem cell and tissue biofabrication.
END

BSF Enterprise PLC:
A Historic Milestone in Luxury and Biotechnology -
World's First T-Rex Leather™ handbag to be auctioned
BSF Enterprise PLC ("BSF" or the "Company"), a global pioneer in lab-grown tissues and sustainable biotechnology, is pleased to announce a landmark event in the evolution of luxury materials. Its subsidiary, Lab-Grown Leather Limited, has officially appointed the prestigious Paris-based auction house Giquello SAS to facilitate the sale of the world
'
s first-ever product crafted from T-Rex Leather™.
Engineered using reconstructed dinosaur collagen and brought to life without harming a single animal, T-Rex
Leather™
made its first public debut
on 2 April,
where the one-of-a-kind, Enfin Leve designed handbag was unveiled at the Art Zoo in Amsterdam.
A Preeminent Stage for a Masterpiece
The auction will be a centerpiece of Giquello
'
s renowned Tentation
°
4 sale, scheduled for 11 June 2026 at the historic Drouot headquarter in Paris. Giquello SAS was specifically selected for its unrivaled expertise in natural history and high-value curiosity sales, providing the perfect bridge between prehistoric legacy and futuristic innovation.
VML Paris, a key partner in the creation of T-Rex Leather™ and a driver of its initial media success, will lead the promotion of the auction, ensuring this historic milestone resonates with audiences worldwide.
BSF views this auction as a transformative opportunity to showcase the Company
'
s innovation to the global market:
●
Global Prestige:
Hosting the event at Drouot, Paris-the epicenter of the French art market-elevates T-Rex Leather™ to the status of a masterpiece, engaging an elite international network of collectors and connoisseurs.
●
Market Disruption:
This milestone validates the commercial viability of the proprietary ATEP™ platform, demonstrating that cultivated leather can compete at the highest echelons of the luxury industry.
●
Brand Amplification:
Collaborating with VML Paris ensures a sophisticated campaign, positioning the brand prominently before luxury, technology, and design audiences worldwide.
CEO Perspective: Defining the Future of Luxury
Dr. Che Connon, CEO of BSF, stated:
"
The auction of the world
'
s first T-Rex Leather™ product in Paris is a watershed moment for our Company and our shareholders. By partnering with Giquello-a titan in the world of rare collectables-we are showcasing the immense value of our cultivated materials on a global stage. With the strategic support of VML Paris, we are not just selling a product; we are introducing a new asset class to the luxury market. This represents the pinnacle of what our biotechnology can achieve, merging the majesty of natural history with the ethics of tomorrow.
This is an exciting moment for T-Rex Leather™ and for the wider potential of cultivated materials in luxury, fashion and design.
"
Why This Matters for Shareholders
This auction serves as a powerful proof of concept for BSF
'
s ability to commercialize high-performance, ethical alternatives to conventional materials. As the world watches the hammer fall in Paris, BSF is solidified as a leader in the multi-billion dollar market for sustainable luxury.
Engage with the Vision: Shareholders are encouraged to engage directly with the management team and view deeper insights regarding this historic announcement via our Interactive Investor website:
https://bsfenterprise.com/link/P7Q5oe.
Further details will be announced in due course, as appropriate.
END

April 2025 Placing - admission update
Further to the announcement published on 28 April 2025 in relation to the placing of 4,725,000 new ordinary shares in the Company at 3 pence per share (the "
April 2025 Placing
Shares
"), the Company has instructed new advisers, Bowsprit Partners, to arrange the application for the April 2025 Placing Shares to be admitted to listing on the Official List and to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange ("

").
The April 2025 Placing Shares were issued on 15 May 2025 pursuant to the placing announced on 28 April 2025. It is expected that Admission will become effective and that dealings in those shares are expected to commence at 8.00 a.m. on 21 April 2026.
Correction to Broker Warrants disclosure
The Company corrects an error in its announcement of 2 April 2026. The number of Broker Warrants was stated as 23,100. The correct number is 2,310,000.
Total voting rights
Following Admission, the total number of ordinary shares and voting rights in the Company will be 166,874,437. The total number of ordinary shares in issue is unchanged from the announcement dated 2 April 2026, as the April 2025 Placing Shares were already issued and included in that figure.
This figure may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure and Transparency Rules.
